assertions.description: getPathData() without settings keeps commands as authored: 'M0 0 l10 0 h5' yields types M, l, h with h carrying one value.
assertions.test: (() => { const p = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'path'); p.setAttribute('d', 'M0 0 l10 0 h5'); const s = p.getPathData(); return s.length === 3 && s[1].type === 'l' && s[2].type === 'h' && s[2].values.length === 1 && s[2].values[0] === 5; })()

assertions.description: getPathData({normalize: true}) returns only absolute M, L, C and Z, converting relative, H/V, Q/T, S and A commands.
assertions.test: (() => { const p = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'path'); p.setAttribute('d', 'm10 10 h20 v20 q5 5 10 0 t10 0 s5 5 10 0 a5 5 0 0 1 10 0 z'); const s = p.getPathData({ normalize: true }); return s.length > 0 && s.every((x) => 'MLCZ'.includes(x.type)) && s[1].type === 'L' && s[1].values[0] === 30; })()

assertions.description: setPathData() accepts plain {type, values} object literals and the written segments read back from getPathData().
assertions.test: (() => { const p = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'path'); p.setPathData([{ type: 'M', values: [1, 2] }, { type: 'L', values: [3, 4] }, { type: 'Z', values: [] }]); const s = p.getPathData(); return s.map((x) => x.type).join('') === 'MLZ' && s[1].values[0] === 3 && s[1].values[1] === 4; })()

assertions.description: setPathData([{}]) throws a TypeError, because SVGPathSegment's type and values are required dictionary members. The check fails when setPathData itself is missing, so a missing API cannot count as a pass.
assertions.test: (() => { const p = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'path'); if (typeof p.setPathData !== 'function') return false; try { p.setPathData([{}]); return false; } catch (e) { return e instanceof TypeError; } })()

assertions.description: getPathData() on a path without a d attribute returns an empty array.
getPathSegmentAtLength(15) on 'M0 0 L10 0 L10 10' returns the second line {type: 'L', values: [10, 10]}, and NaN returns null.
assertions.test: (() => { const p = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'path'); p.setAttribute('d', 'M0 0 L10 0 L10 10'); const s = p.getPathSegmentAtLength(15); return !!s && s.type === 'L' && s.values[0] === 10 && s.values[1] === 10 && p.getPathSegmentAtLength(NaN) === null; })()
